position_overview:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Digital Video Editor to join our growing team on a contractual basis. This role is ideal for a commercially-minded creative who understands the intersection between content, performance marketing, and ecommerce growth.

You will be responsible for creating and optimising high-performing video creatives across TikTok, Meta, and other paid social platforms, helping some of the UK's fastest-growing ecommerce brands acquire customers and scale profitably.

This is more than a traditional editing role. You'll work closely with our creative strategists, media buyers, designers, and content creators to bring concepts to life, identify winning creative patterns, and continuously improve performance through testing and iteration.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional editing skills with a strong understanding of direct-response advertising, short-form content trends, and platform-native creative best practices.

Overview

Launch With Us is one of the fastest-growing advertising agencies in the UK, specialising in ecommerce brands. Since our founding in 2021 by a team of seasoned leaders, we've rapidly expanded with a high-performing team of A-Players. Over the past year, we've successfully managed over 8 million in Meta and TikTok ad spend, delivering profitable results for renowned clients such as Khanum's, Lucy & Lola, Ovrload, DJK, Bubble Panda, and Watermans.

In 2024, we experienced significant growth as an agency, and the Senior Digital Video Editor role will play a pivotal part in our continued expansion and the progression of our performance creative division.

You will join our talented production team, which serves as your creative division. We strategise, ideate, create, and optimise exceptional creative content, including UGC, high-production, design, and motion graphic ads. We pride ourselves on being a one-stop performance creative solution, acting as an in-house creative team for our clients.

Why Join Us?
- Work with some of the UK's fastest-growing ecommerce brands
- Join one of the fastest-growing performance marketing agencies in the UK
- Play a key role in scaling our rapidly growing performance creative division
- Gain exposure to millions in annual Meta and TikTok advertising spend
- Directly influence creative strategy, testing, and campaign performance
- Work alongside experienced strategists, media buyers, designers, and content creators
- Develop your skills in one of the most in-demand areas of digital marketing
- Join a high-performance culture with genuine opportunities for progression
- Fully remote role with flexibility and autonomy
- Lead the editing and optimisation of performance-driven video creatives across multiple ecommerce brands
- Deliver high-quality video content that aligns with each brand's tone of voice, positioning, and commercial objectives
- Specialise in social media advertising content including UGC, motion graphics, and high-production creative assets
- Optimise content for TikTok, Meta (Facebook & Instagram), and emerging platforms to maximise engagement, conversions, and performance
- Apply advanced editing techniques including storytelling, pacing, motion graphics, captions, hooks, and colour grading
- Collaborate with strategists, content creators, designers, and media buyers to translate creative concepts into high-performing assets
- Proactively identify emerging content trends, editing techniques, and creative opportunities that improve campaign results
- Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining exceptional quality standards and meeting deadlines
- Contribute creative ideas and recommendations that improve overall campaign performance

Attitude
- Take full ownership of both your successes and failures
- Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to see the bigger picture
- Proactive, solution-oriented, and adaptable
- Exceptional attention to detail and strong problem-solving skills
- Confident in building long-term relationships
- Ability to self-manage and prioritise effectively in a fast-paced environment

Experience & Skills
- 4+ years of experience producing performance-driven video creatives, ideally within ecommerce, DTC, or agency environments
- Expert proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects; experience with additional creative tools is a plus
- Deep understanding of TikTok, Meta advertising, and short-form video best practices
- Proven ability to create creatives designed to drive engagement, conversions, and revenue
- Advanced knowledge of motion graphics, transitions, captions, storytelling, and colour grading
- Strong understanding of performance marketing principles and creative testing methodologies
- Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work independently or as part of a team
- Excellent communication skills with fluent written and spoken English
- Be part of a world-class team made up of high-performing individuals
- Gain deep insight into how high-growth ecommerce brands scale through performance creative and paid social
- 10 days paid holiday and take your birthday off
- Kudos reward system to earn points and redeem vouchers from brands such as Amazon, Deliveroo, and Just Eat
- Christmas bonus based on performance and tenure

Location: Remote

- Join one of the fastest-growing performance marketing agencies in the UK

- Gain exposure to millions in annual Meta and TikTok advertising spend

- Work alongside experienced strategists, media buyers, designers, and content creators
- Develop your skills in one of the most in-demand areas of digital marketing
- Join a high-performance culture with genuine opportunities for progression
- Fully remote role with flexibility and autonomy

- Lead the editing and optimisation of performance-driven video creatives across multiple ecommerce brands
- Deliver high-quality video content that aligns with each brand's tone of voice, positioning, and commercial objectives
- Specialise in social media advertising content including UGC, motion graphics, and high-production creative assets
- Optimise content for TikTok, Meta (Facebook & Instagram), and emerging platforms to maximise engagement, conversions, and performance

- Expert proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects; experience with additional creative tools is a plus
- Deep understanding of TikTok, Meta advertising, and short-form video best practices
- Proven ability to create creatives designed to drive engagement, conversions, and revenue
- Advanced knowledge of motion graphics, transitions, captions, storytelling, and colour grading
- Strong understanding of performance marketing principles and creative testing methodologies
